method: Download all five reading ZIPs and independent Drive manifest; verify CRC, each volume SHA256 and bytes, reconstruct original source bytes by contiguous offsets and hash Git blob SHA1/SHA256; compare all text and nontext inventory path/SHA/bytes to independent complete fixed Git tree. Receipt uploaded and downloaded byte-identical. Nontext indexed only, not reconstructed in this test; expanded Drive files not individually re-downloaded here; no semantic reading or latest snapshot coverage claim.
